title: 用 Gradio Workflow 重建 AUTOMATIC1111
summary: 本文介绍了如何利用 Gradio Workflow 重新构建 AUTOMATIC1111（Stable Diffusion WebUI）的界面与交互流程。AUTOMATIC1111 是广受欢迎的 Stable Diffusion 图形界面，但其原有架构在扩展性和工作流编排上存在局限。文章展示了通过 Gradio Workflow 这一新特性，将原本分散的 UI 组件和事件处理逻辑重构为可复用的工作流节点，从而提升代码组织性、可维护性与可扩展性。作者详细说明了迁移步骤，包括将原有控件映射为 Workflow 中的节点、处理状态传递与事件触发，以及保持用户操作习惯的兼容性。该方案不仅简化了复杂界面的开发，还为后续集成更多 AI 模型和自定义流程提供了基础。文章面向希望改进 Stable Diffusion 工具链的开发者，强调了 Gradio Workflow 在构建交互式 AI 应用中的潜力，并给出了可参考的代码示例与最佳实践。
summary_en: This article explains how to rebuild AUTOMATIC1111 (Stable Diffusion WebUI) using Gradio Workflow. AUTOMATIC1111 is a popular graphical interface for Stable Diffusion, but its original architecture has limitations in extensibility and workflow orchestration. The article demonstrates how to refactor scattered UI components and event handling logic into reusable workflow nodes using the new Gradio Workflow feature, improving code organization, maintainability, and extensibility. The author details migration steps, including mapping original controls to workflow nodes, handling state passing and event triggering, and maintaining compatibility with user interaction habits. This approach simplifies development of complex interfaces and provides a foundation for integrating more AI models and custom pipelines. Aimed at developers looking to improve the Stable Diffusion toolchain, the article highlights Gradio Workflow's potential for building interactive AI applications and offers code examples and best practices.
